# Draft:Edward Hall (Florida politician)

Edward Hall (1835-?) was a farmer, public official, and politician in Florida. A Republican, he served in office in Lake City, Florida and representing Columbia County, Florida.
He served as Lake City Tax Assessor in 1873 and 1874 and 1876 to 1877. He was a county commissioner in Columbia County, Florida from 1874 to 1877.
